thread:
marta: quick sync — we need promo posts for the benchmark blog + webinar next week. aiming Wed 10am PT X + same-day LinkedIn longform. can we lock assets and cadence?
sam: +1. can you paste the TL;DR copy & CTA? Also confirm hero sizes and whether we have a 1:1 gif.
alex: i have 1 hero variant (1200x628) and a compact 800x800 gif. want me to export in 2 colorways?
marta: yes please. colorway A for X, B for LI. short copy suggestion: "New perf benchmarks: low-latency inference, 60% cost savings on common prompts — demo + webinar Wed" CTA: "Register — seats limited". also need UTM string.
jen: suggest UTM: ?utm_source=social&utm_medium=x&utm_campaign=benchmark_webinar_may
omar: hubspot form is ready. can route registrants > 2 intents to SDR queue (priority: enterprise). is that the plan?
jen: yes, add condition: company_size:>50 or intent_score:>70 => sdr-enterprise, else inbound-nurture.
ops-bot: Deploy reminder: scheduled X post slot available Wed 10:00 PT (slot id: S-09). LinkedIn queue has Tue 09:00 PT open for longform.
eva: i'll write 2 LinkedIn variants: short POV + long story. will ping with the first drafts by EOD today.
sam: for X thread, propose 4 tweets: hook, benchmark stat, how we did it (short), CTA w/ webinar link. also let's pin the 1st comment with registration link and a 30s clip.
alex: uploading assets now to drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/benchmark/webinar/assets — will add color B + gif exports by 3pm.
marta: thanks team — action items: alex upload color B + gifs, eva drafts LI, jen config UTM & HubSpot routing, sam schedules X thread + pin comment. i'll assemble final copy & schedule. if anyone needs different times for APAC, flag now.
omar: flagged for EMEA — can we add a second X push at Wed 18:00 CET? small paid boost to org accounts.
sam: yes can do. checking budget and audience segments (org accounts + lookalike).
jen: finance greenlit up to $400 for boost.
marta: perfect. i'll finalize and share scheduled screenshots here once done :thumbsup:
